sources.snippet: Can we increase LLM context length by averaging adjacent tokens? If language embeddings are redundant across small windows, averaging k consecutive tokens into one halves (or further reduces) the effective sequence length while keeping the model architecture unchanged. This framework provides rigorous empirical analysis to test this hypothesis across five averaging strategies.
